query: PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?n) WHERE { ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:hvdCategory ?c . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?d dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> } }

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?cat (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?n) WHERE { ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:hvdCategory ?c . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?d dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> } OPTIONAL { ?cat dcat:dataset ?d } } GROUP BY ?cat

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?hasCat (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?n) WHERE { ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> . BIND(EXISTS { ?d dcatap:hvdCategory ?c } AS ?hasCat) } GROUP BY ?hasCat

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?l ?t (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s dcatap:applicableLegislation ?l . FILTER(?l != <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> && (CONTAINS(STR(?l),'2023/138') || CONTAINS(STR(?l),'32023R0138') || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?l)),'2023_138'))) OPTIONAL { ?s a ?t } } GROUP BY ?l ?t

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?l ?cat (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?n) WHERE { ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:applicableLegislation ?l . FILTER(?l != <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> && (CONTAINS(STR(?l),'2023/138') || CONTAINS(STR(?l),'32023R0138') || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?l)),'2023_138'))) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?d dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> } OPTIONAL { ?cat dcat:dataset ?d } } GROUP BY ?l ?cat

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?t (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> . ?s a ?t } GROUP BY ?t

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT DISTINCT ?d WHERE { ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> . { ?s dcat:servesDataset ?d } UNION { ?d dcat:distribution ?x . ?x dcat:accessService ?s } }
VALUES batches of 150 over the 'no licence in index' datasets (see scripts/02_sparql.py)

PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT ?p ?o (COUNT(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?n) WHERE { ?cat dcat:dataset ?d . FILTER(?cat = <http://data.europa.eu/88u/catalogue/nkod-opendata-cz>) ?d dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> ; dcat:distribution ?x . ?x dct:license ?t . ?t ?p ?o . FILTER(isIRI(?o)) } GROUP BY ?p ?o ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 60

per catalogue: PREFIX dcat:<http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#> PREFIX dcatap:<http://data.europa.eu/r5r/> PREFIX dct:<http://purl.org/dc/terms/> SELECT DISTINCT ?d WHERE { <http://data.europa.eu/88u/catalogue/paikkatietohakemisto> dcat:dataset ?d . ?d a dcat:Dataset ; dcatap:hvdCategory ?c . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?d dcatap:applicableLegislation <http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2023/138/oj> } } LIMIT 10000
